Open Questions.value: 1. Notes: what was working with Pentagram like? Any partners in particular?

Source.value: Migration import; pentagram.com/about confirmed offices, partner model, disciplines

AI Notes.value: Pentagram is the world's largest independent design consultancy, founded 1972, partner-owned and operated from London, New York, Austin, and Berlin. The partnership model (24 partners, each a practicing designer personally leading client work) is the defining structural feature: partners own the firm, run their own teams, and are the primary contact for clients. This is hands-on creative execution at scale, not a holding-company or ad-agency structure. Type set as Studio per CLAUDE.md bias rule and Pentagram's own self-description as a design studio. Capabilities span graphic design, identity systems, brand strategy, web design, type design, spatial/exhibition design, 3D and motion, and sound, though jonathan's Capabilities field (Graphic design) is locked. Size 100+, Work Status Studio (partner-owned, not a freelance or employed structure). Worked Together: Repeatedly and Familiarity: Know them well are set by jonathan.
